name: request_loan
description: Open the Request Loan page, request a loan of the given amount with the given down payment from account {{account_id}}, and read the loan request status into an output named loan_status

approved_plan.goal: Open the Request Loan page, request a loan of the given amount with the given down payment from account {{account_id}}, and read the loan request status into an output named loan_status

steps.intent: Log in with the supplied credentials and reach the Accounts Overview page
steps.action: Replay parabank_login@1.0.0 with username and password

steps.intent: Navigate to the Request Loan page from the left-hand navigation menu
steps.action: Click the 'Request Loan' link in the authenticated navigation sidebar

steps.intent: Fill in the loan request form with the given loan amount, down payment, and from-account
steps.action: Enter loan_amount into the Loan Amount field, down_payment into the Down Payment field, and select account_id from the From Account dropdown, then submit the form

steps.intent: Read the loan request status from the result page into the output loan_status
steps.action: Capture the loan application status text displayed on the confirmation/result page into loan_status

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username used to log in to ParaBank

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password used to log in to ParaBank

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: The account ID to use as the funding source for the loan down payment

parameters.name: loan_amount
parameters.description: The total amount of the loan being requested

parameters.name: down_payment
parameters.description: The down payment amount for the loan request

approved_plan.success_signal: The loan application result page is displayed, showing a loan request status heading or result message (e.g. "Loan Request Processed" or "Approved"/"Denied" status label) confirming the request was submitted and evaluated

hardening_rejected: s07_extract: detector 'det_loan_denied' rejected: 'Denied' is visible on the page the run just succeeded on, so it can never distinguish that outcome from a genuine one
s07_extract: detector 'det_results_page_missing' rejected: 'Loan Request Processed' is visible on the page the run just succeeded on, so it can never distinguish that outcome from a genuine one
